Keep your place

Automatic matching

Only confirmed, valid matches can reach your account. You always confirm the final changes.

Content filters change this view only. Unknown entries are not assumed safe. Ratings come from explicit backup tags or confirmed platform matches; change them with Edit or Edit selected. To omit NSFW from imports, filter NSFW only, select all filtered, then exclude.

Automatic library matching

Find AniList or MyAnimeList IDs for all included entries. Repeated IDs are combined on import when their tracked status and score agree, keeping the highest progress. Exact unique titles are confirmed automatically; alternative titles and existing tracker links are tried for the rest.

Ready to match your library.

For 1,800 titles, allow roughly an hour or more at the current API request limit. Keep this tab open. Pause, save a project, and reopen it to resume later without repeating completed entries.
